mapper.select: select id, name, code, remark, create_time, update_time from role order by id
select id, name, code, remark, create_time, update_time from role where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into role(name, code, remark, create_time, update_time) values (#{name}, #{code}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select count(*) from employee_role where role_id = #{roleId}
select menu_id from role_menu where role_id = #{roleId} order by menu_id
select r.id, r.name, r.code, r.remark from role r join employee_role er on r.id = er.role_id where er.employee_id = #{employeeId} order by r.id
select role_id from employee_role where employee_id = #{employeeId} order by role_id
